title: JANUS UAP Domain Index — 2026-08-14
purpose: Provide a discoverable read map for the JANUS UAP, nuclear-context, POSS-I transient and human-witness research lineage without rewriting historical artifacts or promoting open results to canonical authority.

authority_boundary.reason: The public POSS-I and Blue Book branches now have reproducible open results, but each retains unresolved provenance/selection controls. Navigation may point to them as active research heads without promoting them to canonical authority.

POSS1_TRANSIENTS_NUCLEAR_UAP_CORRELATION.current_result: The independent fully public POSS-I cohort does not reproduce a positive nuclear-test enhancement in the preregistered +/-1-day window or on exact day +1. Wider negative structure remains unresolved/confounded.

BLUE_BOOK_HUMAN_WITNESS_TEMPORAL_SPECIFI.current_result: A 5,144-page public Blue Book reconstruction yielded 2,091 exact-date study-window cases and 82 blind narrative STARLIKE screens. At +/-1 day there were 8 STARLIKE cases versus null means 12.082 (year-blocked) and 10.609 (year-month-blocked); positive-tail empirical p-values 0.919 and 0.850. Day +1 contains 3 STARLIKE cases. July 1952 contains 76 cases and 4 STARLIKE cases despite zero strict-calendar nuclear-test dates.

OPEN_POSS1_REPRODUCIBILITY.important_boundary: The 122,820-candidate cohort is independently selected and fully public; it is not byte-identical to the unavailable 107,875-source VASCO catalog.

OPEN_BLUE_BOOK_REPRODUCIBILITY.important_boundary: The public mirror population is not established as a complete/unbiased denominator for all historical Blue Book reports. Mirror disposition headers are excluded from inference.

LEGACY_UAP_META.important_note: Legacy confidence labels and Galileo/AARO wording must be read through corrective audits; unresolved and ambiguous observations are not automatically anomalous.

CONUS_NUCLEAR_SITE_UAP_SPATIAL_ANALYSIS.required_next_control: Separate observation provenance, identity resolution, kinematics validation, anomalous-performance validation and origin validation.

HISTORICAL_CLOSED_SAMPLE_REPRODUCIBILITY.blocker: Exact closed 107,875-source VASCO bytes remain unavailable; this no longer blocks independent open tests.

NUCLEAR_UAP_EMULATION_AND_NULLS.role: Synthetic pseudo-event and false-positive controls cannot establish real-world UAP/nuclear causation by themselves.

CROSS_DOMAIN_COSMOLOGY_AND_FALLOUT_ANALO.hard_boundary: UAP/nuclear correlations cannot be upgraded into proof of Many-Worlds branching, new classical universes or non-human agency.

next_read_order_for_execution: 1. Read the open POSS-I result and Blue Book exact-date result side by side.
2. Complete the immutable 24-case Blue Book source/phenotype validation sample without replacing failures.
3. For POSS-I, freeze sky-position/field-density controls and replace tile-minute proxy with exact valid WCS footprint area-time exposure.
4. For the human layer, add event-cluster deduplication and geography/astronomical controls before any physical nuclear-link interpretation.
5. Treat July 1952 as a required non-nuclear positive-control epoch in future human-report models.
6. Only explicitly admitted results may change current-authority.
integrity_rules: This file is navigation, not evidence.
Historical JSONs remain byte/provenance records and are not silently rewritten.
A public non-equivalent catalog may test transport but may not be called an exact replication of a closed catalog.
A convenience mirror is not automatically a complete population denominator or primary authority.
Presentation-layer case labels may not substitute for source-record dispositions.
A nuclear-date coincidence is not specific evidence when the same phenotype has a substantial non-nuclear baseline.
Any future current-authority pointer must target an explicitly admitted canonical artifact.
